tei:div.tei:p: (1)༄༅// lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

"$ (2)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje 'chang chen ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// rta mchog bī ṇa in+d+ra bhū ti'i zhabs// legs smin pā da sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*// gun ri pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma badz+ra dpal ldan chos kyi sde// bzang po'i zhabs dang rje btsun tog rtse pa// bhū ṣa na pa dharma kar+ṇa pa// dpa' bo rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems gdod mas spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i sprin gyis bsgribs pa rnams// skye med bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor gyis// gnyis med ye shes 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa bsam mi khyab pa'i brgyud pa'o// rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med barbi pa// ḍom+bhi ngo mtshar rdo rje nags khrod pa// gar+bha ri pa bsod snyoms mi thub zla// dpa' bo rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun (3)rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyu yi lhan skyes sems nyid skye ba med// lam gyi lhan skyes dug gsum rang sar dag /'bras bu'i lhan skyes rnam thar sgo gsum dang*// sku gsum mngon tu 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/

zhes pa lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud pa'o/ rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje dang*// klu sgrub ār+ya de ba nag po pa// zla ba grags pa bram ze dpal 'dzin zhabs// dpa' bo rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /phyogs bcu'i (4)sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig la sogs pa'i// rtog pa'i dri ma ngan pas ma brtags pa'i// stong nyid zab mo rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lam gyi brgyud pa'o// rdo rje 'chang chen rje btsun sgrol ma dang*// mkhas grub chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags// paṇa chen lha yi 'byung gnas zla ba'i zhabs// don yod rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nam dpal// bsod nam rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /mtha' gnyis spangs par dang por sems bzung zhing*// dran pa'i lcags kyus rang sems rab btul nas// spros bral zab mo'i don la blo bzhag pas// zung 'jug ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i brgyud pa'o// rdo rje 'chang chen bi lā s+ya badz+ra// yan lag med pa'i rdo rje mtsho skyes dang*// in+d+ra legs smin nag po dpal 'dzin zhabs// ga ya dha ra rnams la=

/bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /snod bcud tha mal zhen par rnam rtog kun// bskyed rim zab mo tshul dgu'i rnal 'byor gyis// cir snang lha yi 'khor lor rab shar nas// rnam (5)rtog dbyings su dag par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa pad+ma badz+ra'i lam gyi brgyud pa'o// rdo rje 'chang chen rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje dril bu pa dang ru sbal zhabs// 'bar ba 'dzin pa nag po shrī dha ra// ga ya dha ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /rgyu dang sngags dang ye shes rim pa dang*// gsang dang gnyis su med pa'i rim pa lngas// thog mtha' med pa'i don dam byang chub sems// mtha' bzhi rnam grol rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa'o// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang dbang phyug che// 'chi med dngos grub brnyes pa'i u tsi ṭa// spyod pa'i rdo rje dpal ldan shrī dha ra// ga ya dha ra rnams la= /bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la=

/gzung 'dzin kun rtog skyed byed ro rkyang rlung*// dhū tir g.yo ba med par bcug pa'i mthus// spros bral stong nyid zab mo'i don mthong zhing*// 'chi med dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas (6)rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal bas lung bstan in+d+ra bhū ti che// de yis rjes bzung legs smin ka ra dang*// shes rab gsang ba rnams la= /bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la= /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /dngos po kun khyab sems nyid bde ba che// 'dus byas rkyen gyis mi 'jig rdo rje'i sku// dus gsum 'gyur med ye shes grub pa'i don// phyag rgya'i lam gyis rtogs par byin gyis rlabs// ces pa in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam gyi nye brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa'o// lam skor bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di'ang dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ de rnams kyi kha skong ni/ dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi rjes su/ bud+dha shrī ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// dpal ldan rdo rje rnams la= /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grol mchog lha dbang grags// kun dga' snying po rat+na badz+rī dang*// rin chen rgya mtsho snying po mtha' yas zhabs// kun bzang dbang po rnams la= /tshe dbang nor bu dag dbang rnam par rgyal// kun bzang chos 'byor blo bzang mthu stobs rje// nyi ma chos 'phel blo gsal bstan skyong zhabs// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas bris pa dge/ sarba maṅga laṃ/
